profile_text.body:
Boston Dynamics is a for-profit public company founded in 1992 and headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts, United States. Its website, bostondynamics.com, currently returns only the text "One moment, please...", so no self-description is available from the company's own site.

The available data lists 191 legal exposure entries in Massachusetts. No products, lawsuits, or MCP servers are listed for the company.
